items.instruction: Compile capacity, protected pressure, closure residue, source freshness, and goal pull into the field behind Reality Meridian. It must be caused by runtime state.
Attach Start here to Reality Meridian through a proof seam and receipts. It is a decision layer, not a second primary object.
Represent hard context as an object rim before adding explanatory text.
Expose local proof receipts and replay traces for recommendations and automatic adjustments.
Convert unresolved prior steps into soft closure residue and recovery prompts.
Treat partial completion as a valid continuity artifact.
Map capacity constraints to field grain and compression.
Prevent believable placement through protected or away time.
Decay stale evidence and prevent stale signals from outranking direct commitments.
Show the goal thread pulling the recommended step forward.
